    Why it matters

    A token difference becomes a product decision.

    01

    History retained

    Overestimation can remove useful earlier turns even when they would still fit.

    02

    Overflow risk

    Underestimation can admit too much text and trigger truncation at the real tokenizer boundary.

    03

    Unequal experience

    A language that tokenizes less efficiently can reach the same limit sooner for the same intended meaning.

    Token count is not model quality.

    ContextFair measures budget behavior—not intelligence, cultural understanding, or answer accuracy.
    CFContextFair

    A new application informed by—separate from—the Tokenizer Estimation Study.

    Private prototype · EurekaDev 2026

    Method, honestly

    What you are seeing

    The current build uses fitted script-aware profiles to estimate content tokens. Each Unicode character is assigned to a script class, multiplied by a model-family weight, summed, and rounded up.

    Estimate ≠ exact tokenization.The app deliberately says “estimated.” Exact in-browser verification will be a separate feature with pinned tokenizer assets and provenance.

    The estimator is adapted from MIT-licensed LocalMind work investigated in the independent Tokenizer Estimation Study. Product scenarios and interface code belong to ContextFair.
